title: IDIQ for Hazardous Waste Drums, Reconditioned Steel
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA MARITIME.DLA MARITIME SHIPYARDS.DLA MARITIME - PORTSMOUTH
detail_text: IDIQ for Hazardous Waste Drums PNS intends to solicit for the purchase of Hazardous Waste Drums for the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, ME. This requirement will be solicited as a Full & Open procurement, and the size status for this requirement is 600 employees. Additional details will be provided shortly.
